diagnosis: Messages were persisted and accessible to the treating doctors; scrolling to the end of a tall AI/SOS card hid the human message text above the chat viewport.
scope: Synthetic accounts and demo coordinates. No real emergency calls or dispatch.

checks.name: A large SOS with a shared location cannot hide the next patient message
The primary doctor receives the same message through the conversation list
A second assigned doctor receives the same common-chat message
Doctor replies appear in the patient chat without a reload
A confirmed message appears immediately while the subsequent history request is delayed
Reading history survives polling and the latest-message button reveals a new reply
A 360px mobile chat shows new text even after an expanded emergency card
Reload keeps the latest patient text visible on mobile
